始封子孫曾孫五世六世七世八世九世十世
保定伯梁銘仁宗即位，十二月己巳封，祿千五百石，世襲。宣德二年九月乙未卒於交阯軍中。珤宣德十年二月辛未襲。景泰三年十二月丁未進封侯。五年二月賜誥券，予世襲伯爵。天順元年十月鎮陝西，還領左府。成化三年十二月卒。追封蠡國公，諡襄靖。傅成化四年五月乙亥襲，祿千石。十七年正月卒。
任成化十八年五月丙子襲。弘治九年三月領南京左府。永福正德八年八月壬戌襲。十年閏四月乙丑領南京後府。嘉靖元年改右府。九年五月有罪革任，卒。繼藩嘉靖十四年七月辛未襲。十五年十二月管紅盔將軍。明年十月坐五軍營右哨。二十九年九月戊午領南京前府。隆慶二年十二月提督操江。五年五月癸亥領左府。萬曆二年十一月壬申提督南京操江，兼管巡江。世勛萬曆初襲，屢典軍職。崇禎元年六月乙巳閒住。天秩崇禎十五年五月壬午管紅盔將軍。以上二世襲、卒無考。
忠勤伯李賢洪熙元年正月戊申封。六月癸丑卒，除。
廣義伯吳管者洪熙元年正月戊子封，祿千石，世襲。玘正統四年十一月甲戌襲。景泰七年九月卒。
琮玘從弟。天順二年九月丁亥襲。成化二年七月鎮寧夏。五年六月以罪謫戍，除。
清平侯

Liang Ming, Baron of Baoding, was enfeoffed on jisi in the twelfth month when Renzong ascended the throne, with a hereditary stipend of 1,500 piculs. He died with the army in Jiaozhi on yiwei in the ninth month of Xuande 2.Bao succeeded on xinwei in the second month of Xuande 10, was raised to marquis on dingwei in the twelfth month of Jingtai 3, and in the second month of year 5 received patent and certificate as hereditary earl. In the tenth month of Tianshun 1 he garrisoned Shaanxi and then headed the Left Bureau. He died in the twelfth month of Chenghua 3 and was posthumously made Duke of Li with the posthumous title Xiangjing.Fu inherited the title on yihai in the fifth month of Chenghua 4 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs and died in the first month of year 17.
Ren succeeded on bingzi in the fifth month of Chenghua 18 and in the third month of Hongzhi 9 took charge of the Left Bureau at Nanjing.Yongfu inherited the title on renxu in the eighth month of Zhengde 8, headed the Rear Bureau at Nanjing on yichou in the intercalary fourth month of year 10, and in Jiajing 1 moved to the Right Bureau. He was stripped of office for misconduct in the fifth month of year 9 and died.Jifan succeeded on xinwei in the seventh month of Jiajing 14, commanded the Red-Helmet Guard in the twelfth month of year 15, and the next year in the tenth month was posted to the Right Wing of the Five Armies Camp. On wuwu in the ninth month of year 29 he took the Front Bureau at Nanjing; in the twelfth month of Longqing 2 he supervised Yangzi naval drill, headed the Left Bureau on guihai in the fifth month of year 5, and on renshen in the eleventh month of Wanli 2 supervised Nanjing naval drill while also overseeing river patrol.Shixun inherited the title early in the Wanli reign and held military office repeatedly before being placed on inactive status on yisi in the sixth month of Chongzhen 1.Tianzhi commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on renwu in the fifth month of Chongzhen 15. For the two preceding generations, dates of succession and death are not recorded.
Li Xian, Baron of Zhongqin, was enfeoffed on wushen in the first month of Hongxi 1, died on guichou in the sixth month, and the line was struck off.
Wu Guanzhe, Baron of Guangyi, received the hereditary title on wuzi in the first month of Hongxi 1 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs.Qi inherited the title on jiaxu in the eleventh month of Zhengtong 4 and died in the ninth month of Jingtai 7.
Cong, Qi's younger cousin, succeeded on dinghai in the ninth month of Tianshun 2, garrisoned Ningxia in the seventh month of Chenghua 2, and in the sixth month of year 5 was exiled for misconduct and the line ended.
Marquis of Qingping.
Wu Cheng.
Originally called Maidonkey, Wu Cheng was made baron on renchen in the seventh month of Hongxi 1 with a hereditary stipend of 1,100 piculs, was raised to marquis in the second month of Xuande 4 with 400 piculs added, and died in the twelfth month of year 8. He was posthumously made Duke of Liang with the title Zhuangyong.
Ying.
He inherited the title on bingchen in the second month of Xuande 10.
Xi.
He succeeded on gengshen in the ninth month of Tianshun 8 and died in the ninth month of Chenghua 14.
Cong.
He inherited the title in Chenghua 15, headed the Rear Bureau at Nanjing in the eighth month of Hongzhi 11, and died in the fourth month of year 17.
Jie.
Jie succeeded on xinhai in the third month of Zhengde 3, supervised Divine Engine Camp drill in the fourth month of year 6, garrisoned Huguang in the twelfth month of Jiajing 4, and died on gengshen in the sixth month of year 10.
Jiayan.
He inherited the title on wuzi in the fifth month of Jiajing 20 and in the tenth month of year 27 commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty.
Guoqian.
He succeeded on dinghai in the eighth month of Wanli 4 and died in the tenth month of year 37.
Zunzhou.
He inherited the title on bingwu in the ninth month of Wanli 38, headed the Front Bureau in the sixth month of Tianqi 1, and in Chongzhen 15 was moved to the Central Bureau.

Baron of Huichuan.
Zhao An.
He was enfeoffed in Zhengtong 3 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs, garrisoned Liangzhou, and died in the twelfth month of year 9.
Baron of Ningyuan.
Ren Li.
He was enfeoffed in the fourth month of Zhengtong 3 with a hereditary stipend of 1,200 piculs, died in the first month of Chenghua 1, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Xiwu.
Shou.
Shou succeeded on dingmao in the fifth month of Chenghua 1 and garrisoned Shaanxi, but in the eleventh month of year 4 was exiled for misconduct and the line ended.
Marquis of Dingxi.
Jiang Gui.
He was made Baron of Dingxi in Zhengtong 3 with a stipend of 1,200 piculs, was raised to hereditary marquis in the fifth month of year 7, died in the first month of year 14, and was posthumously made Duke of Jing with the title Wuyong.
Yi.
Wan.
Wan succeeded on xinhai in the tenth month of Zhengtong 14, headed the Left Bureau, in the intercalary sixth month of Chenghua 10 took the Regiment Camp and rose to Grand Guardian, died in the eighth month of year 23, and was posthumously made Duke of Liang with the title Minyi.
Ji.
Ji inherited the title in Chenghua 23, headed the lower five thousand of the Divine Engine Camp in the fourth month of Hongzhi 17, garrisoned Huguang in the second month of year 18 and then Liaodong, and died in the sixth month of Zhengde 4.
Rui.
Rui succeeded on guimao in the twelfth month of Zhengde 4, commanded the lower five thousand of the Divine Engine Camp in the twelfth month of year 10, and in the eleventh month of year 12 held the seal of the Forward Guard of the Palace Army.
Fu.
Fu inherited the title on guiyou in the first month of Jiajing 11, headed the Front Bureau at Nanjing in the fifth month of year 23, was recalled in year 25 and held military office repeatedly, and died on jiazi in the sixth month of year 34.
You.
You succeeded on gengwu in the ninth month of Jiajing 35, headed the Right Bureau in the first month of Longqing 2, moved to the Front Bureau on gengchen in the first month of year 5, and died on renshen in the tenth month of Wanli 3.
Jianyuan.
Jianyuan inherited the title on guichou in the eleventh month of Wanli 3, commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty in the second month of year 4, and in the ninth month of year 20 assisted in the defense of Nanjing.
Chengxun.
Chengxun succeeded on gengchen in the eighth month of Wanli 39 and headed the Front Bureau at Nanjing on bingshen in the sixth month of Tianqi 1.
Weigong.
Weigong inherited the title on jimao in the twelfth month of Tianqi 2, was made Junior Guardian on jiachen in the ninth month of Chongzhen 3, and died in year 13.
Bingzhong.
He inherited the title in Chongzhen 13.
Baron of Xiuwu.
Shen Qing.
He was enfeoffed in the tenth month of Zhengtong 6 with a hereditary stipend of 1,000 piculs, died in the fourth month of year 8, and received the posthumous title Xiangrong.
Rong.
Rong succeeded on jimao in the seventh month of Zhengtong 8, headed the Left Bureau in the tenth month of year 13, and perished at Tumu on renxu in the eighth month of year 14, whereupon his title was struck off; early in Tianshun he was posthumously restored as marquis with the title Ximin.
Yu.
Yu was allowed to inherit in the fifth month of Jingtai 3 as a reward for the installation of empress and heir, with a stipend of 800 piculs; late in Tianshun he garrisoned Jizhou and then Ningxia, but in Chenghua 13 lost his title for misconduct.
Qi.
He inherited the title during the Chenghua reign, died, and left no son.
Fang.
Fang succeeded on jiachen in the eleventh month of Chenghua 23, died on jisi in the third month of Hongzhi 6, and his son inherited as commandant.
Baron of Yongning.
Tan Guang.
Tan Guang was enfeoffed on guimao in the eleventh month of Zhengtong 6, died in the tenth month of year 9 with the posthumous title Xiangyi, was posthumously made marquis in the ninth month of Chenghua 3, and his son inherited as commandant.
Baron of Jingyuan.
Wang Ji.
Wang Ji was enfeoffed on renshen in the fifth month of Zhengtong 7 as a civil minister of the Fengtian order with a stipend of 1,200 piculs, soon raised by 300, died in the fifth month of Tianshun 4, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhongyi.
Chang.
Chang inherited the title on yimao in the tenth month of Tianshun 4 and died in the second month of Chenghua 7.
Tian.
Tian succeeded in Chenghua 8, was posted to the Five Armies Camp in the fifth month of year 12, and died in the eighth month of year 15.
Xian.
Xian inherited the title in the second month of Chenghua 19, early in Hongzhi commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty, in Zhengde 8 held the Forward Guard of the Palace Army, and died in the twelfth month of year 9.
Jin.
Jin inherited the title in the fourth month of Zhengde 10, held military office repeatedly, and garrisoned the two Guang on guisi in the ninth month of Jiajing 34.
Xueshi.
He inherited the title on xinhai in the first month of Wanli 1.
Xueli.
Xueli succeeded on guiyou in the fourth month of Wanli 4, headed the Left Bureau on renshen in the second month of year 19 and then the Central Bureau, and died in year 41.
Jifang.
Jifang inherited the title on wuchen in the seventh month of Wanli 41 and died within a year.
Yong'en.
Also called Chengen, he succeeded on bingyin in the seventh month of Wanli 43, headed the Left Bureau at Nanjing on renzi in the third month of Tianqi 6, and in the second month of Chongzhen 14 supervised affairs at Pukou and Hechi.
Baron of Pingxiang.
Chen Huai.
Chen Huai was enfeoffed on bingyin in the third month of Zhengtong 9, perished at Tumu in year 14, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhongyi.
Fu.
He inherited the title on renchen in the eleventh month of Zhengtong 14.
Zheng.
Zheng succeeded on gengshen in the first month of Jingtai 6, garrisoned the two Guang in Chenghua 8, and died in the eleventh month of year 21.
Xin.
Xin inherited the title on bingzi in the twelfth month of Chenghua 22, died in the first month of Hongzhi 6, and his son succeeded as commandant.
Baron of Zhaoyuan.
Ma Liang.
Ma Liang was enfeoffed on the same day as Chen Huai, died in the seventh month of year 11 with the posthumous title Rongyi, and his son inherited as commandant.
Baron of Zhongyong.
Jiang Xin.
Jiang Xin was enfeoffed in the Zhengtong reign, died, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Xishun.
Shan.
Shan succeeded on dingyou in the eighth month of Jingtai 5, received an added stipend of 1,100 piculs in the third month of Tianshun 1, died in the Hongzhi period without heirs, and the line ended.
Baron of Mengyin.
Li Ying.
When Emperor Yingzong took the throne, Li Ying was posthumously enfeoffed in the third month with the posthumous title Xiangyi.
Baron of Miangu.
Gao Wen.
Gao Wen died on jiazi in the twelfth month of Zhengtong 1 and was posthumously enfeoffed with the title Zhuangjing.
Baron of Huaiyuan.
Shan Yun.
Shan Yun was posthumously enfeoffed in the eleventh month of Zhengtong 3 with the title Zhongyi.
Baron of Weiyuan.
Fang Zheng.
Fang Zheng was posthumously enfeoffed in the eighth month of Zhengtong 5 with the title Zhongyi.
Baron of Biyang.
Han Xi.
Han Xi was posthumously enfeoffed in the ninth month of Zhengtong 5 with the title Rongxiang.
Baron of Linwu.
Xiao Shou.
Xiao Shou was posthumously enfeoffed in Zhengtong 10.
Baron of Laiyang.
Sun Rong.
Sun Rong was posthumously enfeoffed during the Zhengtong reign.
Baron of Shanyang.
Jin Chun.
Jin Chun was posthumously enfeoffed as a civil minister during the Zhengtong reign.
Baron of Chiping.
Wu Zhong.
Wu Zhong was posthumously enfeoffed as a civil minister in the sixth month of Zhengtong 7 with the title Rongxiang.

昌平侯
楊洪
景帝即位，八月辛未封昌平伯。十一月乙丑進封侯，世襲。二年九月卒。追封潁國公，諡武襄。
傑
景泰二年襲。四年二月卒。
俊
景泰四年五月乙丑襲。
珍
景泰七年十二月丙辰襲。天順元年坐附于謙除。成化十七年四月詔許襲爵。
定襄伯
郭登
景泰元年閏正月庚午封，祿千二百石，世襲。天順元年二月領南京中府，坐罪奪爵。八年三月壬辰復。成化八年四月卒。追封侯，諡忠武。
嵩
登從子。成化八年十二月乙丑襲，祿七百石。十三年六月領南京前府，尋改提督操江。十四年正月卒。子襲指揮使。
撫寧伯
朱謙
景泰元年九月丁未封。二年二月卒。天順元年十月追封侯。成化五年諡武襄。保國公
永
景泰二年八月辛未襲，予世券。成化三年正月壬申進封侯。十五年進封公，世襲，祿二千石，累加太師。弘治二年三月掌後府。九年二月卒。追封宣平王，諡武莊。
暉
弘治九年六月甲辰襲公，子孫仍世侯。十六年六月提督團營。正德六年八月卒。撫寧侯
麒
正德七年四月襲侯。十二年十二月鎮兩廣。九年三月坐奮武營管操。嘉靖十二年十二月鎮湖廣。十三年三月守備南京。十七年加祿三百石，其年卒。
岳
嘉靖十七年襲。二十一年四月僉書中府。四十二年二月掌左府。
崗
隆慶二年七月壬子襲。萬曆十八年九月壬寅卒。
繼勳
萬曆十九年襲。二十三年十二月癸丑掌府軍前衞。三十七年九月丁未歸自南京，至臨清，為關使所逼，自殺。
國弼
萬曆四十六年閏四月丙寅襲。天啟元年六月領中府，有罪革祿。莊烈帝即位，十一月庚午復。崇禎四年正月己未守南京，兼領中府，累加少傅。十一年正月削爵。十六年四月壬午復。
南和侯
方瑛
政子。景泰五年封伯，世襲。天順元年七月戊子追封侯，子孫世襲伯，祿千二百石。三年十一月卒。諡忠襄。
襲伯
毅
天順四年十二月庚寅襲，以罪革爵。
壽祥
成化十七年四月丙辰襲。弘治三年八月坐五軍營左哨。十四年三月，顯武營管操。正德四年九月鎮貴州。嘉靖間再僉南京軍府。十七年九月丁丑卒。諡康順。
東
嘉靖十八年九月戊戌襲。二十七年十一月丁酉坐揚威營。三十年九月卒。
炳
嘉靖三十三年十一月己酉襲，屢掌兩京軍府。
應奇
隆慶二年襲。卒，無子，叔??襲。
??
炳從弟，隆慶六年正月癸未襲。萬曆十九年正月丙午任中府僉書。二十七年十二月卒。
一元
萬曆四十三年三月丙辰襲。天啟六年三月領南京後府。餘無考。
南寧伯
毛勝
景泰五年封，世襲，鎮金齒。天順二年八月卒。追封侯，諡莊毅。
榮
天順三年十二月乙卯襲，以罪謫廣西。成化二年復鎮貴州。五年十一月鎮兩廣。六年正月卒。
文
成化七年二月戊午襲。十四年二月提督操江。弘治元年九月協守南京。六年八月卒。
良
弘治七年二月丙子襲。十五年三月，三千營管操。十八年九月領南京後府。正德十一年十二月管紅盔將軍上直。嘉靖七年二月坐奮武營管操。十九年十一月戊戌卒。
重器
嘉靖二十一年七月丙寅襲。二十八年十二月丁酉坐立威營。三十四年二月戊寅卒。
邦器
嘉靖三十四年九月癸巳襲。四十年卒。
國器
嘉靖四十一年六月癸丑襲。四十五年二月領南京前府。
祖德
一作得祖。萬曆二十三年九月乙酉襲。三十五年管紅盔將軍上直。
孟龍
一作夢龍。天啟中襲。崇禎九年卒。
茂龍
崇禎十年二月甲午襲。
鉅鹿侯

Marquis of Changping.
Yang Hong.
When Emperor Jing took the throne, Yang Hong was made Baron of Changping on xinwei in the eighth month, was raised to hereditary marquis on yichou in the eleventh month, and died in the ninth month of year 2. He was posthumously made Duke of Ying with the title Wuxiang.
Jie.
Jie inherited the title in Jingtai 2 and died in the second month of year 4.
Jun.
Jun inherited the title on yichou in the fifth month of Jingtai 4.
Zhen.
Zhen inherited the title on bingchen in the twelfth month of Jingtai 7, lost it in Tianshun 1 for his association with Yu Qian, and was permitted to resume the title by edict in the fourth month of Chenghua 17.
Baron of Dingxiang.
Guo Deng.
Guo Deng was enfeoffed on gengwu in the intercalary first month of Jingtai 1 with a hereditary stipend of 1,200 piculs, headed the Central Bureau at Nanjing in the second month of Tianshun 1 and lost his title for misconduct, was restored on renchen in the third month of year 8, died in the fourth month of Chenghua 8, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhongwu.
Song.
Song, Guo Deng's nephew, inherited the title on yichou in the twelfth month of Chenghua 8 with a stipend of 700 piculs, headed the Front Bureau at Nanjing in the sixth month of year 13 and was then put in charge of naval drill on the Yangzi, died in the first month of year 14, and his son inherited as commandant.
Baron of Funing.
Zhu Qian.
Zhu Qian was enfeoffed on dingwei in the ninth month of Jingtai 1, died in the second month of year 2, was posthumously made marquis in the tenth month of Tianshun 1, and received the posthumous title Wuxiang in Chenghua 5.Duke Who Protects the State.
Yong.
Yong inherited the title on xinwei in the eighth month of Jingtai 2 with patent and certificate, was raised to marquis on renshen in the first month of Chenghua 3, was made hereditary duke in year 15 with a stipend of 2,000 piculs and rose to Grand Preceptor, headed the Rear Bureau in the third month of Hongzhi 2, died in the second month of year 9, and was posthumously made Prince of Xuanping with the title Wuzhuang.
Hui.
Hui inherited the dukedom on jiachen in the sixth month of Hongzhi 9 while his descendants continued to hold the marquisate, supervised the Regiment Camp in the sixth month of year 16, and died in the eighth month of Zhengde 6.Marquis of Funing.
Qi.
Qi inherited the marquisate in the fourth month of Zhengde 7, garrisoned the Two Guangs in the twelfth month of year 12, was put in command of the Fenwu Camp in the third month of year 9, garrisoned Huguang in the twelfth month of Jiajing 12, defended Nanjing in the third month of year 13, received a 300-picul stipend increase in year 17, and died that year.
Yue.
Yue inherited the title in Jiajing 17, served as vice director of the Central Bureau in the fourth month of year 21, and headed the Left Bureau in the second month of year 42.
Gang.
Gang inherited the title on renzi in the seventh month of Longqing 2 and died on renyin in the ninth month of Wanli 18.
Jixun.
Jixun inherited the title in Wanli 19, headed the Front Guard of the Palace Army on guichou in the twelfth month of year 23, and on dingwei in the ninth month of year 37, while returning from Nanjing to Linqing, was driven by a customs officer to take his own life.
Guobi.
Guobi inherited the title on bingyin in the intercalary fourth month of Wanli 46, headed the Central Bureau in the sixth month of Tianqi 1 and lost his stipend for misconduct, was restored on gengwu in the eleventh month when Emperor Zhuanglie took the throne, defended Nanjing and concurrently headed the Central Bureau on jiwei in the first month of Chongzhen 4 while rising to Junior Tutor, had his title struck off in the first month of year 11, and was restored on renwu in the fourth month of year 16.
Marquis of Nanhe.
Fang Ying.
Fang Ying, Fang Zheng's son, was made hereditary baron in Jingtai 5, was posthumously raised to marquis on wuzi in the seventh month of Tianshun 1 with descendants holding the barony at a stipend of 1,200 piculs, died in the eleventh month of year 3, and received the posthumous title Zhongxiang.
Succeeded as baron.
Yi.
Yi inherited the title on gengyin in the twelfth month of Tianshun 4 and was stripped of it for misconduct.
Shouxiang.
Shouxiang inherited the barony on bingchen in the fourth month of Chenghua 17, was assigned to the Left Wing of the Five Armies Camp in the eighth month of Hongzhi 3, took command of the Xianwu Camp in the third month of year 14, garrisoned Guizhou in the ninth month of Zhengde 4, served again as vice director of a Nanjing military bureau during the Jiajing reign, died on dingchou in the ninth month of year 17, and received the posthumous title Kangshun.
Dong.
Dong inherited the barony on wuxu in the ninth month of Jiajing 18, was put in command of the Yangwei Camp on dingyou in the eleventh month of year 27, and died in the ninth month of year 30.
Bing.
Bing inherited the barony on jiyou in the eleventh month of Jiajing 33 and repeatedly headed military bureaus in both capitals.
Yingqi.
Yingqi inherited the barony in Longqing 2, died without sons, and was succeeded by his younger male cousin Fang Ye.
Fang Ye.
Fang Ye, Bing's younger male cousin, inherited the barony on guiwei in the first month of Longqing 6, served as vice director of the Central Bureau on bingwu in the first month of Wanli 19, and died in the twelfth month of year 27.
Yiyuan.
Yiyuan inherited the barony on bingchen in the third month of Wanli 43, headed the Rear Bureau at Nanjing in the third month of Tianqi 6, and no further details are recorded.
Baron of Nanning.
Mao Sheng.
Mao Sheng was enfeoffed in Jingtai 5 with a hereditary title and garrisoned Jinchi, died in the eighth month of Tianshun 2, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhuangyi.
Rong.
Rong inherited the title on yimao in the twelfth month of Tianshun 3 and was banished to Guangxi for misconduct, garrisoned Guizhou again in Chenghua 2, garrisoned the Two Guangs in the eleventh month of year 5, and died in the first month of year 6.
Wen.
Wen inherited the title on wuwu in the second month of Chenghua 7, supervised naval drill on the Yangzi in the second month of year 14, jointly defended Nanjing in the ninth month of Hongzhi 1, and died in the eighth month of year 6.
Liang.
Liang inherited the title on bingzi in the second month of Hongzhi 7, commanded drill in the Three Thousand Camp in the third month of year 15, headed the Rear Bureau at Nanjing in the ninth month of year 18, commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty in the twelfth month of Zhengde 11, was posted to the Fenwu Camp in the second month of Jiajing 7, and died on wuxu in the eleventh month of year 19.
Zhongqi.
Zhongqi inherited the title on bingyin in the seventh month of Jiajing 21, was posted to the Liwei Camp on dingyou in the twelfth month of year 28, and died on wuyin in the second month of year 34.
Bangqi.
Bangqi inherited the title on guisi in the ninth month of Jiajing 34 and died in year 40.
Guoqi.
Guoqi inherited the title on guichou in the sixth month of Jiajing 41 and in the second month of year 45 headed the Front Bureau at Nanjing.
Zude.
Also written Dezu. Zude inherited the title on yiyou in the ninth month of Wanli 23 and in year 35 commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty.
Menglong.
Also written Menglong. Menglong inherited the title during the Tianqi reign and died in Chongzhen 9.
Maolong.
Maolong inherited the title on jiawu in the second month of Chongzhen 10.
Marquis of Julu.
Jing Yuan.
Imperial son-in-law; Jing Yuan perished at Tumu. When Emperor Jing took the throne, he was posthumously enfeoffed.
Baron of Renqiu.
Liang Cheng.
Left Regional Commander; Liang Cheng perished at Tumu and was posthumously enfeoffed.
Baron of Shanyang.
Wu Xing.
Wu Xing was posthumously enfeoffed during the Jingtai reign.
Baron of Liyang.
Ji Guang.
Ji Guang died in the first month of Jingtai 4 and was posthumously enfeoffed with the title Xishun.
Shunning.
Shunning inherited the title in the seventh month of Jingtai 4.
Baron of Shuyang.
Jin Lian.
Jin Lian was posthumously enfeoffed as a civil official during the Jingtai reign.

嘉靖四十二年四月乙卯襲。
夢熊
襲年無考。萬曆三十二年六月己酉，後府僉書。天啟元年六月甲申領南京後府。崇禎三年九月甲辰加太師。
懷柔伯
施聚
與曹義同日封，祿千一百石，世襲。六年九月卒。追封侯，諡威靖。
榮
天順七年六月癸亥襲。成化元年正月卒。
鑑
成化元年六月丁酉襲。四年八月有罪奪爵，謫貴州，立功。十三年四月復。弘治三年八月坐練武營。四年二月，南京協同守備。八年正月卒。
瓚
一作璜。弘治八年十二月乙亥襲，領南京左府。九年十二月，神機營左哨坐營管操。嘉靖八年十二月癸酉卒。
瑾
嘉靖中襲。
燾
嘉靖十五年五月丙子襲。三十四年六月己巳卒。
嵩
嘉靖三十五年十二月壬寅襲。隆慶三年三月壬申卒。
光祖
隆慶四年十月庚子襲。
壯猷
萬曆三十四年四月壬子襲。崇禎四年二月庚午領南京左府。七年卒。
兆麟
崇禎十年正月襲。
武功伯
徐有貞
天順元年三月癸酉以文臣封，祿千一百石，世指揮使。尋以罪謫，除。
武平侯
陳友
天順元年七月戊子封伯，祿千一百石，世襲。三年四月己巳進封侯，子孫仍世伯，加祿百石。四年三月卒。弘治三年六月追封沔國公，諡武僖。
襲伯
能
天順四年六月戊辰襲。成化八年六月停祿，尋復。十九年七月卒。
綱
成化二十年三月癸丑襲，祿千石，管紅盔將軍上直。弘治四年兼坐揚威營。八年三月卒。
勳
弘治九年四月壬寅襲。正德元年五月領右府。二年二月，三千營管操。四年十月卒。
熹
正德五年襲。
大策
嘉靖十三年閏二月丙寅襲。萬曆五年閏八月卒。
永壽
萬曆五年十二月乙未襲。按實錄，時有武平伯陳如松者，萬曆十九年正月庚戌管理紅盔將軍。世次、襲年無考。
世恩
襲年無考。天啟五年十二月管紅盔將軍。崇禎三年九月甲辰加太子太傅。
定遠侯
石彪
與陳友同日封伯，祿千一百石，世襲。三年四月己巳進封侯，加祿百石。四年二月以罪誅，除。
高陽伯
李文
與陳友同日封，祿千石，失事褫爵。弘治二年十二月卒。追贈伯爵。子襲指揮使。
武強伯
楊能
洪從子。與陳友同日封，祿千石。四年十一月卒。無子，除。
宣城伯
衞穎
天順元年十一月甲子封，祿一千一百石，予世襲。成化元年四月掌右府。八年八月管後府。弘治十一年卒。追封侯，諡壯勇。
璋
弘治十一年五月乙丑襲。
錞
正德十三年正月癸卯襲。十六年二月坐果勇營。嘉靖十四年五月提督神機營。十八年二月為留守。三十六年正月卒。贈太傅。
守正
嘉靖三十六年五月丙子襲。三十七年十月僉書後府。隆慶二年五月丁丑卒。
國本
隆慶二年八月甲辰襲。五年正月庚辰掌府軍前衞。萬曆中，屢僉軍府。
應爵
萬曆二十八年九月辛丑襲。三十五年卒。
時泰
萬曆三十九年二月己卯襲。崇禎三年九月甲辰加太保。十七年三月闔門死難。
彰武伯
楊信
洪從子。天順二年封，祿千石。八年七月予世襲。成化十三年十二月卒。追封侯，諡武毅。
瑾
成化十四年四月丁巳襲。弘治二年四月卒。
質
弘治十年三月戊申襲，給祿千石。嘉靖十一年三月，右府僉書。十七年七月戊戌卒。
儒
嘉靖十八年正月丁酉襲。四十一年五月卒。
炳
嘉靖四十一年十二月丙子襲。隆慶四年八月領左府。十一月協守南京。五年十一月總京營。萬曆十一年九月乙未加太子太傅。十四年三月卒。贈太保。
世階
襲年無考。萬曆三十八年六月領左府。四十九年卒。
崇猷
泰昌元年十二月辛酉襲。
First enfeoffment.Son (first generation).Grandson (second generation).Great-grandson (third generation).Fifth generation.Sixth generation.Seventh generation.Eighth generation.Ninth generation.Tenth generation.
Duke of Zhong.
Shi Heng.
When Emperor Jing took the throne, Shi Heng was made Baron of Wuqing on xinwei in the eighth month, was raised to marquis on renxu in the tenth month, and on renwu in the first month of Tianshun 1 was advanced to duke with a stipend of 1,500 piculs. In the first month of year 4, convicted of a crime, he was imprisoned and died; the title was abolished.
Marquis of Taiping.
Zhang Yue.
Younger brother of Fu, Zhang Yue was enfeoffed on renwu in the first month of Tianshun 1 with a hereditary stipend of 2,000 piculs, died in the third month of year 2, and was posthumously made Duke of Yu with the title Yongxiang.
Jin.
Jin inherited the title on wuzi in the seventh month of Tianshun 2 and the title was abolished on gengzi in the sixth month of Chenghua 1.
Baron of Wen'an.
Zhang Ni.
Elder brother of Yue, Zhang Ni was enfeoffed the same day as Yue with a hereditary stipend of 1,200 piculs, died in the second month of Tianshun 6, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhongxi.
Bin.
Bin inherited the title on gengyin in the sixth month of Tianshun 6; found guilty in the eighth month of year 7, the title was abolished.
Baron of Xingji.
Yang Shan.
Yang Shan was enfeoffed on bingxu in the first month of Tianshun 1 as a military minister of the Fengtian order with a hereditary stipend of 1,200 piculs, died in the fifth month of year 2, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhongmin.
Zong.
Zong inherited the title on dingyou in the ninth month of Tianshun 2 and in Chenghua 1 was granted hereditary commandant.
Baron of Haining.
Dong Xing.
Dong Xing was enfeoffed on jichou in the first month of Tianshun 1 with a hereditary stipend of 1,100 piculs, died in the eleventh month of Chenghua 12, and the title was abolished.
Marquis of Huaining.
Sun Tang.
Sun Tang was enfeoffed as Baron of Huaining on jichou in the first month of Tianshun 1, was raised to hereditary marquis in the seventh month of year 5, died on dinghai in the first month of Chenghua 7, and was posthumously made Duke of Lai with the title Wuyi.
Fu.
Fu inherited the title on jichou in the fifth month of Chenghua 7 and died in the second month of year 16.
Tai.
Tai inherited the title on bingyin in the twelfth month of Chenghua 16 and died in the tenth month of Hongzhi 14.
Yingjue.
Yingjue inherited the title on gengwu in the twelfth month of Hongzhi 15, was posted to the Shenwei Camp in the intercalary fourth month of year 17, commanded the Divine Engine Camp in the twelfth month of Zhengde 3, headed the Front Bureau in the seventh month of year 4 and also supervised the Regiment Camp in the tenth month, and died in the sixth month of year 12.
Ying.
Ying inherited the title on guimao in the first month of Zhengde 13, commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty in the twelfth month of year 15, and died in the seventh month of Jiajing 18.
Mao.
Mao inherited the title in Jiajing 18 and died in year 23.
Bingyuan.
Bingyuan inherited the title on wuyin in the fourth month of Jiajing 23, was posted to the Xiaoyong Camp on yichou in the twelfth month of year 27, and died on jiwei in the tenth month of year 37.
Shizhong.
Shizhong inherited the title on jiawu in the third month of Jiajing 38, commanded the Red-Helmet Guard in the sixth month of year 44, jointly defended Nanjing and headed the Rear Bureau in the third month of Longqing 1, defended Nanjing and headed the Central Bureau in the tenth month of year 4, garrisoned Huguang in the second month of Wanli 1, died on wuzi in the eleventh month of Wanli 20, and was granted state funeral rites.
Chengen.
Chengen inherited the title on guihai in the third month of Wanli 29.
Chengyin.
During the Wanli reign Chengyin supervised naval drill on the Yangzi and on wuwu in the eleventh month of Chongzhen 1 was removed from the Yangtze patrol post.
Jijun.
Jijun inherited the title on wuyin in the seventh month of Chongzhen 4.
Weifan.
Weifan inherited the title during the Chongzhen reign.
Baron of Fengrun.
Cao Yi.
Cao Yi was enfeoffed on jiachen in the second month of Tianshun 1 with a hereditary stipend of 1,300 piculs, died in the first month of Tianshun 4, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhuangwu.
Zhen.
Zhen inherited the title in the seventh month of Tianshun 4, was posted to the Divine Engine Camp in the fifth month of Chenghua 16, supervised naval drill on the Yangzi in the fourth month of Hongzhi 1, and died in the fifth month of year 2.
Kai.
Kai inherited the title on gengzi in the second month of Hongzhi 3, garrisoned Guizhou, supervised naval drill on the Yangzi in the eleventh month of Zhengde 15, and died on jiaxu in the sixth month of Jiajing 5.
Dong.
Dong inherited the title on dingmao in the tenth month of Jiajing 5 and died on gengyin in the first month of year 7.
Song.
Song was Dong's elder half-brother; he inherited the title in Jiajing 7, repeatedly commanded military bureaus, and defended Nanjing.
Wenbing.
Wenbing inherited the title on wuxu in the eleventh month of Jiajing 40, headed the Left Bureau at Nanjing in the tenth month of year 43, and again headed the Left Bureau on bingwu in the tenth month of Longqing 5.
Yuncheng.
Yuncheng inherited the title on gengwu in the sixth month of Wanli 23 and died in year 43.
Kuangzhi.
Kuangzhi inherited the title on wuxu in the second month of Chongzhen 1, was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent on jiachen in the ninth month of year 2, and on xinchou in the fourth month of year 11 became assistant director of the Left Bureau.
Baron of Dongning.
Jiao Li.
Jiao Li was enfeoffed the same day as Cao Yi with a hereditary stipend of 1,200 piculs, died in the first month of Tianshun 7, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Xiangyi.
Liang.
Shou.
Shou inherited the title in the first month of Tianshun 7, was posted to the Three Thousand Camp in the twelfth month, garrisoned Shaanxi in the eighth month of Chenghua 1, and died in the eleventh month of year 8.
Jun.
Jun inherited the title on dingchou in the tenth month of Chenghua 9, was posted to the Three Thousand Camp in the fourth month of Hongzhi 3, headed the Front Bureau at Nanjing and supervised naval drill on the Yangzi in the third month of year 8, garrisoned Guizhou in the second month of year 11, and died in the ninth month of year 13.
Qi.
Also written Hong. Qi inherited the title on wuxu in the eleventh month of Hongzhi 14 with a stipend of 800 piculs, garrisoned the Two Guangs in the second month of Zhengde 5, and died on jiachen in the tenth month of year 6.
Xun.
Xun inherited the title in Zhengde 8 and died on yimao in the seventh month of year 14.
Dong.
Dong, Xun's nephew, inherited the title on dinghai in the second month of Zhengde 16, was posted to the Liwei Camp in the eleventh month of Jiajing 5, commanded the Five Armies Camp in the third month of year 10, headed the Central Bureau in the sixth month of year 14, carried the seal of Right Vice General on imperial escort in the second month of year 18, died on jiaxu in the first month of year 36, and was granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
Wenyao.
Wenyao inherited the title on yimao in the fourth month of Jiajing 42.
Mengxiong.
Mengxiong inherited the title in an unknown year, became assistant director of the Rear Bureau on jiyou in the sixth month of Wanli 32, headed the Rear Bureau at Nanjing on jiashen in the sixth month of Tianqi 1, and was made Grand Preceptor on jiachen in the ninth month of Chongzhen 3.
Baron of Huairou.
Shi Ju.
Shi Ju was enfeoffed the same day as Cao Yi with a hereditary stipend of 1,100 piculs, died in the ninth month of Tianshun 6, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Weijing.
Rong.
Rong inherited the title on guihai in the sixth month of Tianshun 7 and died in the first month of Chenghua 1.
Jian.
Jian inherited the title on dingyou in the sixth month of Chenghua 1, was stripped of his title in the eighth month of year 4 and banished to Guizhou where he performed meritorious service, was restored in the fourth month of year 13, was posted to the Lianwu Camp in the eighth month of Hongzhi 3, jointly defended Nanjing in the second month of year 4, and died in the first month of year 8.
Zan.
Also written Huang. Zan inherited the title on yihai in the twelfth month of Hongzhi 8 and headed the Left Bureau at Nanjing, commanded drill in the Left Wing of the Divine Engine Camp in the twelfth month of year 9, and died on guiyou in the twelfth month of Jiajing 8.
Jin.
Jin inherited the title during the Jiajing reign.
Tao.
Tao inherited the title on bingzi in the fifth month of Jiajing 15 and died on jisi in the sixth month of year 34.
Song.
Song inherited the title on renyin in the twelfth month of Jiajing 35 and died on renshen in the third month of Longqing 3.
Guangzu.
Guangzu inherited the title on gengzi in the tenth month of Longqing 4.
Zhuangyou.
Zhuangyou inherited the title on renzi in the fourth month of Wanli 34, headed the Left Bureau at Nanjing on gengwu in the second month of Chongzhen 4, and died in year 7.
Zhaolin.
Zhaolin inherited the title in the first month of Chongzhen 10.
Baron of Wugong.
Xu Youzhen.
Xu Youzhen was enfeoffed on guiyou in the third month of Tianshun 1 as a civil official with a stipend of 1,100 piculs as hereditary commandant, but was soon banished for a crime and the title was abolished.
Marquis of Wuping.
Chen You.
Chen You was enfeoffed as baron on wuzi in the seventh month of Tianshun 1 with a hereditary stipend of 1,100 piculs, was raised to marquis on jisi in the fourth month of year 3 while his descendants continued to hold the barony with 100 piculs added, died in the third month of Tianshun 4, and was posthumously made Duke of Mian in the sixth month of Hongzhi 3 with the title Wuxi.
Baron inheritor.
Neng.
Neng inherited the title on wuchen in the sixth month of Tianshun 4, had his stipend suspended in the sixth month of Chenghua 8 and soon restored, and died in the seventh month of year 19.
Gang.
Gang inherited the title on guichou in the third month of Chenghua 20 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs and commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty, was also posted to the Yangwei Camp in the fourth month of Hongzhi 4, and died in the third month of year 8.
Xun.
Xun inherited the title on renyin in the fourth month of Hongzhi 9, headed the Right Bureau in the fifth month of Zhengde 1, commanded drill in the Three Thousand Camp in the second month of year 2, and died in the tenth month of year 4.
Xi.
Xi inherited the title in Zhengde 5.
Dace.
Dace inherited the title on bingyin in the intercalary second month of Jiajing 13 and died in the intercalary eighth month of Wanli 5.
Yongshou.
Yongshou inherited the title on yiwei in the twelfth month of Wanli 5. According to the Veritable Records, Baron of Wuping Chen Rusong at that time managed the Red-Helmet Guard on gengxu in the first month of Wanli 19; generation order and year of succession are unknown.
Shien.
Shien inherited the title in an unknown year, commanded the Red-Helmet Guard in the twelfth month of Tianqi 5, and was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent on jiachen in the ninth month of Chongzhen 3.
Marquis of Dingyuan.
Shi Biao.
Shi Biao was enfeoffed as baron the same day as Chen You with a hereditary stipend of 1,100 piculs, was raised to marquis on jisi in the fourth month of year 3 with 100 piculs added, and was executed for a crime in the second month of year 4; the title was abolished.
Baron of Gaoyang.
Li Wen.
Li Wen was enfeoffed the same day as Chen You with a stipend of 1,000 piculs but was stripped of his title for misconduct, died in the twelfth month of Hongzhi 2 and was posthumously granted baron's rank, and his son inherited as commandant.
Baron of Wuqiang.
Yang Neng.
Yang Neng, Hong's nephew, was enfeoffed the same day as Chen You with a stipend of 1,000 piculs, died in the eleventh month of Tianshun 4 without sons, and the title was abolished.
Baron of Xuancheng.
Wei Ying.
Wei Ying was enfeoffed on jiazi in the eleventh month of Tianshun 1 with a stipend of 1,100 piculs and hereditary status, headed the Right Bureau in the fourth month of Chenghua 1, managed the Rear Bureau in the eighth month of year 8, died in Hongzhi 11, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhuangyong.
Zhang.
Zhang inherited the title on yichou in the fifth month of Hongzhi 11.
Chun.
Chun inherited the title on guimao in the first month of Zhengde 13, was posted to the Guoyong Camp in the second month of year 16, supervised the Divine Engine Camp in the fifth month of Jiajing 14, served as capital garrison commander in the second month of year 18, died in the first month of year 36, and was granted Grand Tutor.
Shouzheng.
Shouzheng inherited the title on bingzi in the fifth month of Jiajing 36, became assistant director of the Rear Bureau in the tenth month of year 37, and died on dingchou in the fifth month of Longqing 2.
Guoben.
Guoben inherited the title on jiachen in the eighth month of Longqing 2, took charge of the Front Guard of the Palace Army on gengchen in the first month of year 5, and during the Wanli reign repeatedly served as assistant director of military bureaus.
Yingjue.
Yingjue inherited the title on xinchou in the ninth month of Wanli 28 and died in year 35.
Shitai.
Shitai inherited the title on jimao in the second month of Wanli 39, was made Grand Guardian on jiachen in the ninth month of Chongzhen 3, and in the third month of year 17 his entire household died in martyrdom.
Baron of Zhangwu.
Yang Xin.
Yang Xin, Hong's nephew, was enfeoffed in Tianshun 2 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs, was granted hereditary status in the seventh month of year 8, died in the twelfth month of Chenghua 13, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Wuyi.
Jin.
Jin inherited the title on dingsi in the fourth month of Chenghua 14 and died in the fourth month of Hongzhi 2.
Zhi.
Zhi inherited the title on wushen in the third month of Hongzhi 10 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs, became assistant director of the Right Bureau in the third month of Jiajing 11, and died on wuxu in the seventh month of year 17.
Ru.
Ru inherited the title on dingyou in the first month of Jiajing 18 and died in the fifth month of year 41.
Bing.
Bing inherited the title on bingzi in the twelfth month of Jiajing 41, headed the Left Bureau in the eighth month of Longqing 4, jointly defended Nanjing in the eleventh month, commanded the Capital Camp in the eleventh month of year 5, was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent on yiwei in the ninth month of Wanli 11, died in the third month of year 14, and was granted Grand Guardian.
Shijie.
Shijie inherited the title in an unknown year, headed the Left Bureau in the sixth month of Wanli 38, and died in year 49.
Chongyou.
Chongyou inherited the title on xinyou in the twelfth month of Taichang 1.

右天順朝。

始封子孫曾孫五世六世七世八世九世十世
武靖侯
趙輔
成化二年十一月庚辰封伯。祿千二百石。四年正月進封侯，予世伯。二十二年六月卒，追封容國公，諡恭肅。
襲伯
承慶
成化末襲。弘治元年三月領神機營五千下管操。九月掌府軍前衞。八年三月協守南京兼右府。正德二年七月癸亥卒。
弘澤
正德三年七月庚辰襲。四年十月坐五軍營。六年四月掌前府。十五年十二月管紅盔將軍上直。
世爵
嘉靖八年襲。十年十二月壬寅坐五軍營。二十年四月，右府僉書。二十二年七月甲寅卒。
國斌
嘉靖二十三年四月戊寅襲。
光遠
萬曆二年六年戊申襲。四年二月，左府僉書。十四年正月鎮湖廣。
祖蔭
萬曆二十四年五月庚辰襲。三十七年二月壬申協守南京後府。四十年卒。
祖芳
萬曆四十二年十月己丑襲。
邦鎮
世系、襲年無考。
伏羌伯
毛忠
成化三年四月庚子封，祿千石。四年十一月討滿四戰沒。追封侯，予世伯。
銳
成化五年四月丁丑襲。弘治元年正月鎮湖廣。二年十月移鎮兩廣。十七年六月加太子太傅。正德四年十月提督漕運。世宗即位，命鎮湖廣，卒。贈太傅，諡威襄。
江
嘉靖三年九月甲子襲。四年十一月坐神機營五千下。十二年四月鎮湖廣。十三年卒。
漢
嘉靖十三年五月癸未襲，屢典南京軍府，提督操江、漕運。
桓
漢從子。嘉靖三十三年九月壬寅襲。三十四年十一月，南京後府僉書。三十七年八月癸酉卒。
登
嘉靖三十九年八月壬戌襲。四十五年五月僉書左府。隆慶五年十月丙午領中府。萬曆二十年二月丙年卒。
承祚
崇禎四年正月壬寅襲。十二年四月丙申領右府。自登至承祚，世系無考。
順義伯
羅秉忠
成化四年八月己酉封。十六年十二月卒。諡榮壯，停襲。
靖安伯
和勇
成化五年六月癸亥封。十年二月卒。諡武敏。子襲指揮使。
寧晉伯
劉聚
成化七年三月甲申封，祿千石。九年六月予世襲。十年四月卒。追封侯，諡威勇。
祿
成化十年閏六月襲。
福
成化十一年六月乙酉襲，祿八百石。弘治十三年八月佐後府。明年十月卒。
岳
弘治十五年三月癸巳襲。正德十六年五月坐耀武營。
文
嘉靖六年襲。
良璽
嘉靖二十三年四月戊寅襲。無子。叔斌襲。
斌
嘉靖三十五年二月庚子襲。隆慶四年十月辛丑卒。
應芳
萬曆三年正月乙丑襲。
天錫
萬曆三十年七月乙酉襲。
光溥
崇禎十一年六月乙卯襲。十三年二月辛末，後府僉書管事。十四年五月領右府。
興寧伯
李震
成化十二年九月庚申封，祿千石。十四年有罪削爵。二十年九月復。二十二年八月卒，停襲。
威寧伯
王越
成化十六年以文臣封，世襲。十七年二月加太子太傅，卒。贈太傅，諡襄敏，停襲。
昌寧伯
趙勝
成化十九年十月丙戌封。二十三年七月卒。追封侯，諡壯敏。予其後指揮使。
固原伯
劉玉
成化七年十一月卒。以右都督追封，諡毅敏。
宣良伯
冉保
成化中，左都督，追封。
First enfeoffment.Son (first generation).Grandson (second generation).Great-grandson (third generation).Fifth generation.Sixth generation.Seventh generation.Eighth generation.Ninth generation.Tenth generation.
Marquis of Wujing.
Zhao Fu.
Zhao Fu was enfeoffed as baron on gengchen in the eleventh month of Chenghua 2 with a stipend of 1,200 piculs, was raised to marquis in the first month of year 4 with hereditary baronial status granted to his line, died in the sixth month of year 22, and was posthumously made Duke of Rong with the title Gongsu.
Baron inheritor.
Chengqing.
Chengqing inherited the title at the end of the Chenghua reign, commanded drill in the lower five thousand of the Divine Engine Camp in the third month of Hongzhi 1, took charge of the Front Guard of the Palace Army in the ninth month, jointly defended Nanjing while heading the Right Bureau in the third month of year 8, and died on guihai in the seventh month of Zhengde 2.
Hongze.
Hongze inherited the title on gengchen in the seventh month of Zhengde 3, was posted to the Five Armies Camp in the tenth month of year 4, headed the Front Bureau in the fourth month of year 6, and commanded the Red-Helmet Guard on palace duty in the twelfth month of year 15.
Shijue.
Shijue inherited the title in Jiajing 8, was posted to the Five Armies Camp on renyin in the twelfth month of year 10, became assistant director of the Right Bureau in the fourth month of year 20, and died on jiayin in the seventh month of year 22.
Guobin.
Guobin inherited the title on wuyin in the fourth month of Jiajing 23.
Guangyuan.
Guangyuan inherited the title on wushen in Wanli 6, became assistant director of the Left Bureau in the second month of year 4, and garrisoned Huguang in the first month of year 14.
Zuyin.
Zuyin inherited the title on gengchen in the fifth month of Wanli 24, jointly defended Nanjing and headed the Rear Bureau on renshen in the second month of year 37, and died in year 40.
Zufang.
Zufang inherited the title on jichou in the tenth month of Wanli 42.
Bangzhen.
Generation order and year of succession are unknown.
Baron of Fuxiang.
Mao Zhong.
Mao Zhong was enfeoffed on gengzi in the fourth month of Chenghua 3 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs, died campaigning against Man Si in the eleventh month of year 4, and was posthumously made marquis with hereditary baronial status granted to his line.
Rui.
Rui inherited the title on dingchou in the fourth month of Chenghua 5, garrisoned Huguang in the first month of Hongzhi 1 and was transferred to the Two Guangs in the tenth month of year 2, was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent in the sixth month of year 17, supervised grain transport in the tenth month of Zhengde 4, was ordered to garrison Huguang when Emperor Shizong took the throne and died there, and was granted Grand Tutor with the title Weixiang.
Jiang.
Jiang inherited the title on jiazi in the ninth month of Jiajing 3, was posted to the lower five thousand of the Divine Engine Camp in the eleventh month of year 4, garrisoned Huguang in the fourth month of year 12, and died in year 13.
Han.
Han inherited the title on guiwei in the fifth month of Jiajing 13 and repeatedly commanded Nanjing military bureaus while supervising naval drill on the Yangzi and grain transport.
Huan.
Huan, Han's nephew, inherited the title on renyin in the ninth month of Jiajing 33, became assistant director of the Rear Bureau at Nanjing in the eleventh month of year 34, and died on guiyou in the eighth month of year 37.
Deng.
Deng inherited the title on renxu in the eighth month of Jiajing 39, became assistant director of the Left Bureau in the fifth month of year 45, headed the Central Bureau on bingwu in the tenth month of Longqing 5, and died in the second month of Wanli 20.
Chengzuo.
Chengzuo inherited the title on renyin in the first month of Chongzhen 4 and headed the Right Bureau on bingshen in the fourth month of year 12; generation order from Deng to Chengzuo is unknown.
Baron of Shunyi.
Luo Bingzhong.
Luo Bingzhong was enfeoffed on jiyou in the eighth month of Chenghua 4, died in the twelfth month of year 16 with the posthumous title Rongzhuang, and succession was suspended.
Baron of Jing'an.
He Yong.
He Yong was enfeoffed on guihai in the sixth month of Chenghua 5, died in the second month of year 10 with the posthumous title Wumin, and his son inherited as commandant.
Baron of Ningjin.
Liu Ju.
Liu Ju was enfeoffed on jiashen in the third month of Chenghua 7 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs, was granted hereditary status in the sixth month of year 9, died in the fourth month of year 10, and was posthumously made marquis with the title Weiyong.
Lu.
Lu inherited the title in the intercalary sixth month of Chenghua 10.
Fu.
Fu inherited the title on yiyou in the sixth month of Chenghua 11 with a stipend of 800 piculs, assisted in the Rear Bureau in the eighth month of Hongzhi 13, and died in the tenth month of the following year.
Yue.
Yue inherited the title on guisi in the third month of Hongzhi 15 and was posted to the Yaowu Camp in the fifth month of Zhengde 16.
Wen.
Wen inherited the title in Jiajing 6.
Liangxi.
Liangxi inherited the title on wuyin in the fourth month of Jiajing 23 but had no sons, whereupon his uncle Bin succeeded.
Bin.
Bin inherited the title on gengzi in the second month of Jiajing 35 and died on xinchou in the tenth month of Longqing 4.
Yingfang.
Yingfang inherited the title on yichou in the first month of Wanli 3.
Tianxi.
Tianxi inherited the title on yiyou in the seventh month of Wanli 30.
Guangpu.
Guangpu inherited the title on yimao in the sixth month of Chongzhen 11, became assistant director of the Rear Bureau in charge of affairs on xinmo in the second month of year 13, and headed the Right Bureau in the fifth month of year 14.
Baron of Xingning.
Li Zhen.
Li Zhen was enfeoffed on gengshen in the ninth month of Chenghua 12 with a stipend of 1,000 piculs, was stripped of his title for a crime in year 14, was restored in the ninth month of year 20, died in the eighth month of year 22, and succession was suspended.
Baron of Weining.
Wang Yue.
Wang Yue was enfeoffed in Chenghua 16 as a hereditary civil official, was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent in the second month of year 17 and died, was granted Grand Tutor with the title Xiangmin, and succession was suspended.
Baron of Changning.
Zhao Sheng.
Zhao Sheng was enfeoffed on bingxu in the tenth month of Chenghua 19, died in the seventh month of year 23, was posthumously made marquis with the title Zhuangmin, and his descendants were granted commandant.
Baron of Guyuan.
Liu Yu.
Liu Yu died in the eleventh month of Chenghua 7 and was posthumously enfeoffed as Right Regional Commander with the title Yimin.
Baron of Xuanliang.
Ran Bao.
Ran Bao was Left Regional Commander during the Chenghua reign and was posthumously enfeoffed.
524
右成化朝。
At right: entries for the Chenghua reign.
始封子孫曾孫五世六世七世八世九世十世
廣昌伯
劉寧
弘治中，左都督，追封。
涇陽伯
神英
正德五年四月庚子封。以附劉瑾除。
咸寧侯
仇鉞
正德五年九月丙辰封伯，世襲。七年十月進封侯。十六年五月卒。
鸞
嘉靖元年襲。三年十月，顯武營管操。七年三月坐奮武營管操。十六年九月鎮寧夏。十八年二月掛左副將軍印扈駕。二十三年正月鎮甘肅。二十六年十二月有罪逮捕下獄。二十七年三月出獄。三十一年八月壬戌卒。追戮屍，除。
洛南伯
馮禎
正德中，副總兵，追封。
邢臺伯
馮斌
正德中，右都督，追封。
新建伯
王守仁
世宗即位，十一月丁巳以文臣封，祿千石，世襲。隆慶元年四月甲寅追封侯，諡文成。
正億
隆慶初襲。萬曆五年卒。
承勳
萬曆五年襲。二十年督漕運。三十年十二月以督漕久勞，加太子太保。天啟五年正月卒於家。
先通
承勳從子。崇禎十二年十月辛丑襲。十七年三月死於賊。
忠誠伯
陸炳
嘉靖中，左都督，追封。
寧遠伯
李成梁
萬曆七年五月丙辰封，祿八百石。二十九年三月鎮遼東。三十四年六月庚子卒。
如松
萬曆二十六年四月死事遼東，追贈加少保，諡忠烈。
尊祖
崇禎十年閏四月甲子襲。
寧南伯
左良玉
崇禎十七年三月癸巳封。
定西伯
唐通
與良玉同日封。降於賊。
靖南伯
黃得功
與良玉同日封。
First enfeoffment.Son (first generation).Grandson (second generation).Great-grandson (third generation).Fifth generation.Sixth generation.Seventh generation.Eighth generation.Ninth generation.Tenth generation.
Baron of Guangchang.
Liu Ning.
Liu Ning was Left Regional Commander during the Hongzhi reign and was posthumously enfeoffed.
Baron of Jingyang.
Shen Ying.
Shen Ying was enfeoffed on gengzi in the fourth month of Zhengde 5, but the title was abolished for his association with Liu Jin.
Marquis of Xianning.
Qiu Yue.
Qiu Yue was enfeoffed as hereditary baron on bingchen in the ninth month of Zhengde 5, was raised to marquis in the tenth month of year 7, and died in the fifth month of year 16.
Luan.
Luan inherited the title in Jiajing 1, commanded drill in the Xianwu Camp in the tenth month of year 3, was assigned to command drill in the Fenwu Camp in the third month of year 7, garrisoned Ningxia in the ninth month of year 16, carried the seal of Left Vice General on imperial escort in the second month of year 18, garrisoned Gansu in the first month of year 23, was arrested and imprisoned in the twelfth month of year 26 and released in the third month of year 27, died on renxu in the eighth month of year 31, and was posthumously executed in effigy with the title abolished.
Baron of Luonan.
Feng Zhen.
Feng Zhen was Vice Commander-in-Chief during the Zhengde reign and was posthumously enfeoffed.
Baron of Xingtai.
Feng Bin.
Feng Bin was Right Regional Commander during the Zhengde reign and was posthumously enfeoffed.
Baron of Xinjian.
Wang Shouren.
When Emperor Shizong took the throne, Wang Shouren was enfeoffed as a civil official on dingsi in the eleventh month with a hereditary stipend of 1,000 piculs and was posthumously made marquis on jiayin in the fourth month of Longqing 1 with the title Wencheng.
Zhengyi.
Zhengyi inherited the title at the beginning of the Longqing reign and died in Wanli 5.
Chengxun.
Chengxun inherited the title in Wanli 5, supervised grain transport in Wanli 20, was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent in the twelfth month of year 30 for long service on transport duty, and died at home in the first month of Tianqi 5.
Xiantong.
Xiantong, Chengxun's nephew, inherited the title on xinchou in the tenth month of Chongzhen 12 and died at the hands of rebels in the third month of year 17.
Baron of Zhongcheng.
Lu Bing.
Lu Bing was Left Regional Commander during the Jiajing reign and was posthumously enfeoffed.
Baron of Ningyuan.
Li Chengliang.
Li Chengliang was enfeoffed on bingchen in the fifth month of Wanli 7 with a stipend of 800 piculs, garrisoned Liaodong in the third month of year 29, and died on gengzi in the sixth month of year 34.
Rusong.
Rusong died in service in Liaodong in the fourth month of Wanli 26 and was posthumously granted Junior Guardian with the title Zhonglie.
Zunzu.
Zunzu inherited the title on jiazi in the intercalary fourth month of Chongzhen 10.
Baron of Ningnan.
Zuo Liangyu.
Zuo Liangyu was enfeoffed on guisi in the third month of Chongzhen 17.
Baron of Dingxi.
Tang Tong.
Tang Tong was enfeoffed the same day as Zuo Liangyu and surrendered to the rebels.
Baron of Jingnan.
Huang Degong.
Huang Degong was enfeoffed the same day as Zuo Liangyu.
571
右自弘治至崇禎朝。
